plan: PLAN.md Phase 3: the monthly Lakeflow drift job, per-skin-type drift alerts, the prediction audit table, label delay
model_and_scores: the serving bundle evaluated in results/phase3/serving/results.json (manifest SHA-256 checked); ensemble probabilities and the ensemble Mahalanobis OOD score, on CPU as the API computes them
baseline: the ensemble OOD scores of the clients' validation split (3,210 images), computed once by the job on CPU with the same bundle and stored in workspace.cdm.gold_drift_baseline

replay.what: real shifts replayed in a chosen order, 300 images a month, drawn without replacement with numpy default_rng(0) from each pool across the whole schedule; real and staged drift are never mixed: every image is a real image from its source
replay.after_month_12: no more replay; the run logs the live check only

drift_tests.ks: two-sample Kolmogorov-Smirnov on the month's ensemble OOD scores against the baseline (scipy.stats.ks_2samp, two-sided)
drift_tests.psi: population stability index over 10 bins at the baseline's deciles, with 1e-6 added to empty bins

per_skin_type: the same tests per Fitzpatrick type wherever the month has at least 100 images of that type (the Phase 2 rule), against the whole baseline; smaller types are logged with counts only and never alert. Skin type is recorded only at Buenos Aires and PAD-UFES-20
label_delay: a month's accuracy (balanced accuracy over the classes present and melanoma sensitivity where it has 100 melanomas, else counts) is reported by the following month's run, as if diagnoses arrive a month late; drift is judged without labels
live_check: each run asks the ISIC Archive API for its public image count and logs the change since the last run; months with no change are logged as no new data. New images are not downloaded or scored by this job

tables.workspace.cdm.gold_drift_monthly: one row per month: counts by source, KS statistic and p, PSI, alert and warning flags, abstain share, per-skin-type results, the delayed accuracy of the previous month, the live count
tables.workspace.cdm.gold_prediction_audit: one row per scored image: request ID, model version and bundle manifest SHA-256, input SHA-256, ISIC ID, month, label, class probabilities, OOD score, abstain and referral flags, timestamp (the API adds nothing: the owner's condition)

reading_months_1_to_4: months 1 to 4 are in-distribution (test against a validation baseline): an alert there is a false alarm, and is reported as one
